decisions.change: Register search at L5, the lowest layer above its agent-plugins L4 contribution dependency. No layer rule or exception changed.

Move shared reader contracts/refusal identity to core/filesystem; platform reexports the same identity. Inject the existing containment, locking and atomic-write owners into vibecoding through ProjectFilesystemPort. Bind owner-store SQL repo in server opening composition rather than inside its service.

Move concrete owner-store assembly/service/backups and integration tests to server/owner-store, leaving pinned schema history in db/owner-store. Inject the credentialed-http executor into SavedRequestDeps; move its shared validation-error identity to integrations/contracts.

Create the executable-identity cache in createClaudeFilesystemSupportProbe and bind one check per createAgentExecutor. Keep concurrency deduplication, mtime invalidation, uncertainty caching, timeout budgets and why-comment.
